name: forward_bounds_record_to_handler
description: Copies four 16-bit values from the caller's record into local storage and passes them, along with the first two values, to a routine whose pointer is read from a global table. The record itself is not changed.

name: draw_bounded_region_passes
description: Derives a width and height from the four-value bounds record and issues four calls to one routine with those dimensions. The calls pair fixed constants (0 with 24, 255 with 4, 192 with 1, and 48 with 2), and the last two use the caller's offset values as their destination position.

name: clip_region_then_draw
description: Returns without action when the starting point lies outside the bitmap's width and height. Otherwise it shortens the width and height arguments so the region stays inside the bitmap, then passes all arguments to a routine.

name: set_global_word_value
description: Stores its single 16-bit argument into a fixed global variable and returns. It is the write side of a simple setter.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect. It can be called safely wherever a do-nothing routine is needed.

name: save_blocks_to_new_file
description: Opens the file named by a global string in new-file mode and, if the open succeeds, writes four 8000-byte blocks from a pointer table followed by a 32-byte global block. The handle is then closed, and nothing is written when the open fails.

name: write_table_blocks_then_close
description: Writes four 8000-byte blocks from a pointer table and then a 32-byte global block to the file handle kept in the frame, and then closes that handle. It is the write-and-close part of the save sequence without the open.

name: write_global_block_and_close
description: Writes a 32-byte global block to the file handle kept in the frame and then closes it. It is the final portion of the save sequence.

name: draw_fixed_position_sequence
description: Makes eight calls through a graphics library base: a single call with the value 4, four calls with coordinates computed from global values, a call with the value 0, and two more coordinate calls. The sequence draws a fixed pattern at offsets taken from global variables.

name: set_flag_for_global_match
description: Compares its pointer argument with the pointer to one particular global buffer and sets a global flag to 1 when they match. Otherwise the flag is left unchanged.

name: compute_signed_division_quotient
description: Divides the value in the first register by the value in the second using a 32-step restoring division on absolute values. The quotient is negated when the two inputs have opposite signs, and zero is returned when either input is zero.

name: read_then_write_back_value
description: Calls one routine with selector 0 to fetch a value into a local slot, makes two parameterless calls, then sets the slot to a register result and passes it back with selector 1. It returns the value held in the slot.

name: pass_frame_slot_selector_one
description: Passes selector 1 and a pointer to a frame slot at offset 4 to a routine and then returns. It is a one-line wrapper for writing that slot.

name: transfer_saved_long_both_ways
description: When the first argument is zero, copies a saved 32-bit value into the location given by the pointer argument. Otherwise it stores the value at that pointer into the saved location, so it serves as both getter and setter for one long word.

name: find_free_slot_and_call
description: Scans a table of 24-byte records for the first one whose byte at offset 16 is zero, stopping at a fixed end marker. If no record is free it returns zero; otherwise it passes the arguments and the found record to a second routine and returns its result.

name: call_handler_if_slot_valid
description: Returns zero when the slot pointer kept in the frame equals the table end marker. Otherwise it forwards two frame arguments and that slot pointer to a routine and returns its result.

name: forward_frame_args_to_handler
description: Passes two arguments and a slot pointer from the caller's frame to a routine and returns with no result of its own.

name: open_stream_from_mode_string
description: Parses a mode string whose first character selects read, write or append and whose optional second character selects binary mode or a plus sign for update. It opens the file with the matching flags, seeks to the end when appending, and fills a stream record with its buffer and mode bits, returning the record or zero when the open fails or the mode is invalid.

name: open_stream_from_frame_mode
description: Performs the same mode-string parsing and file opening as its sibling, reading the mode and the stream record from the calling frame. It opens the file with the matching flags, seeks to the end when appending, and returns the filled stream record, or zero on failure.

name: open_append_stream_and_init
description: Opens a file for appending by combining the supplied flags with write-create bits and a fixed permission value, then seeks to the end. It fills a stream record in the same way as the general opener and returns it, or zero when the open fails.

name: seek_end_and_init_stream
description: Seeks the file handle to its end and then stores a mode value of 2, or 128 when the plus-sign flag is present. It fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits and returns the record.

name: finish_stream_record_mode_two
description: Stores the mode value 2 and fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits, returning the record.

name: open_read_stream_and_init
description: Opens a file for reading, adding update access when a plus sign is present, and returns zero if the open fails. On success it stores a mode value of 1, or 128 with the plus sign, and fills a stream record.

name: open_existing_file_and_init
description: Opens the file named by the first argument with a flags value kept in the frame and returns zero if the open fails. On success it stores a mode value of 1, or 128 with the plus-sign flag, and fills a stream record.

name: finish_stream_record_plus_mode
description: Stores a mode value of 1, or 128 when the plus-sign flag is present, and fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits. It returns the record.

name: finish_stream_record_mode_one
description: Stores a mode value of 1 and fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits, returning the record.

name: open_write_stream_and_init
description: Opens a file for writing with the write flags and a fixed permission value, adding update access when a plus sign is present, and returns zero on failure. On success it stores a mode value of 2, or 128 with the plus sign, and fills a stream record.

name: open_update_stream_and_init
description: Opens a file with the frame's flags combined with write bits and a fixed permission value, returning zero on failure. On success it stores a mode value of 2, or 128 with the plus sign, and fills a stream record.

name: finish_stream_record_write_mode
description: Stores a mode value of 2, or 128 when the plus-sign flag is present, then fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits and returns it.

name: finish_stream_record_mode_two
description: Stores the mode value 2 and fills a stream record with its buffer pointer and mode bits, returning the record.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the value zero and performs no other work.

name: fill_stream_record_fields
description: Fills a stream record from the frame. When a global flag is set it marks the mode byte as buffered and points the buffer pointer into the record itself, otherwise it clears that pointer; it then zeroes the counters, stores the mode byte and returns the record.

name: init_stream_record_no_buffer
description: Clears the stream record's buffer pointer and counters, then stores the mode byte from the frame. It returns the record.

name: clear_object_links
description: Makes a release call when a flag bit is set, then calls a routine with two stored fields if the related flags are clear and the second field is non-zero. It zeroes those two fields and the flag byte, and finally passes a byte taken from the record to a routine.

name: check_flag_and_return_pointer
description: Runs a setup call when a global is set, then for an in-range index looks up a slot and checks its flag byte. When the top bit is set it returns a pointer into the table from a second lookup; otherwise it sets a global status to 9 and returns null.

name: allocate_file_slot_and_open
description: Searches the slot table for a free entry and returns -1 with a status code when the table is full. It then sets the slot's access bits from the mode argument, opens the file in one of two modes chosen by the write bits, and stores the handle, clearing the slot and returning -1 if the open fails.

name: validate_slot_and_open_file
description: Rejects an index equal to the table size, then sets the slot's access bits from the mode argument and opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode. It stores the handle and returns the index, or clears the slot and returns failure when the open fails.

name: lookup_slot_and_open_file
description: Finds the slot for the current index through a lookup, sets its access bits from the mode argument, and opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode. It stores the handle and returns the index, clearing the slot and returning failure when the open fails.

name: open_file_into_prepared_slot
description: Marks the slot as in use and sets its access bits from the mode argument, rejecting unsupported combinations with a status code. It opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode and stores the handle, clearing the slot and returning failure if the open fails.

name: open_file_with_slot_access
description: Sets access value 32 in the slot, adds an option bit from the mode argument, and optionally runs a setup call. It then opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode, storing the handle and clearing the slot on failure.

name: open_file_with_access_only
description: Sets access value 32 in the slot, optionally runs a setup call, and opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode chosen by the write bits. It stores the handle and clears the slot on failure, otherwise returning the index.

name: open_file_with_combined_option
description: Sets access value 96 in the slot with an option bit taken from the mode argument, optionally runs a setup call, and opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode chosen by the write bits. It stores the handle and clears the slot on failure, otherwise returning the index.

name: open_file_with_combined_access
description: Sets access value 96 in the slot, optionally runs a setup call, and opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode chosen by the write bits. It stores the handle and clears the slot on failure, otherwise returning the index.

name: reject_invalid_slot_access
description: Clears the slot's flag byte, sets a global status code of 22 and returns failure. It is the error exit for an unsupported access mode.

name: open_file_into_slot_tail
description: Optionally runs a setup call when a flag is set, then opens the file in an existing-file or new-file mode chosen by the write bits and stores the handle. It clears the slot and returns failure if the open fails, otherwise returning the index.

name: open_existing_file_into_slot
description: Opens the file in existing-file mode and stores the handle in the slot. On failure it clears the slot, records a status code of 2 and returns failure; otherwise it returns the index from the frame.

name: return_frame_index_value
description: Returns the value stored in the frame and changes nothing else.

name: reissue_with_adjusted_mode_flags
description: Keeps the top bit of the second argument, adds write-related bits, and clears the top bit from the remaining value. It then calls the same routine with the first argument unchanged and returns nothing of its own.

name: dispatch_io_on_slot_handle
description: Looks up the file record for the slot index and, when one exists, passes its handle with the other arguments to an I/O routine. A failure from that routine records an I/O error with status 5, while a negative index or missing record sets status 22 and returns -1.

name: read_from_slot_handle
description: Reads from the file whose handle is held in the slot record into a buffer for the requested length and returns the result of the read. A failed read records an I/O error with status 5.

name: write_to_slot_handle
description: Looks up the slot record for a valid index and, when its flag bit is set, first seeks to the end of the file. It then writes the buffer for the requested length and returns the result, recording an I/O error with status 5 if the write fails.

name: seek_file_with_offset_table
description: Looks up the file record and, for an index below three, seeks the file to an offset taken from a global table, recording status 22 if that seek fails. It then seeks back to the start of the file and returns that result, while an invalid record or index sets status 22 and returns an error value.

name: close_handle_if_flag_clear
description: Looks up the file record for the given index and returns failure when none exists. When the record's flag bit is set it returns success without closing; otherwise it closes the stored handle, clears the record's flag byte and returns success.

name: delete_file_with_status
description: Deletes the file named by its argument and returns zero on success. When the delete fails it records an I/O error with status 2 and returns -1.

name: forward_single_argument
description: Passes its single argument to a routine and returns without using a result.

name: rename_file_with_status
description: Renames a file from the first name to the second. On failure it records an I/O error with status 5 and returns -1; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns the value zero and performs no other work.

name: open_global_file_handle
description: Opens the file named by the global string in existing-file mode and stores the resulting handle in a global variable.

name: read_byte_with_pending_pushback
description: Runs an optional setup call and then returns a pending byte held in a global when one is present, clearing it. Otherwise it reads one byte from the global file handle into a local and returns that byte.

name: read_single_byte_from_handle
description: Reads one byte from the global file handle into a local slot and returns that byte. The result of the read is not checked.

name: write_byte_to_handle
description: Runs optional setup calls when two global values are in particular states, then writes its single-byte argument to the global file handle. It returns that byte.

name: store_byte_if_empty
description: Returns -1 when the global byte is already set. Otherwise it stores the low byte of its argument in that global and returns the argument.

name: store_argument_byte_global
description: Copies the low byte of the first frame argument into a global byte variable. No result is returned.

name: close_active_handles
description: Walks a table of entries up to a global count and closes each entry whose first byte is nonzero and whose flag bit is clear. It then passes its two arguments to another routine.

name: init_drive_unit_and_dma
description: Copies a 20-byte template into the caller's record and sets one unit-select bit in it from the second argument. It then disables all interrupts, sets the disk-controller control and DMA registers and the disk sync word, and returns a value read from the interrupt request register.

name: return_fixed_numeric_constant
description: Returns the fixed value 6875 and performs no other work.

name: copy_string_until_terminator
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination, including the terminating zero byte, and returns the destination pointer.

name: copy_string_with_length_limit
description: Copies at most a given number of bytes from the source into the destination, stopping after a zero byte. The destination is always ended with a zero byte, and its pointer is returned.

name: initialise_session_state_fields
description: Copies two entries from a text table into a buffer and clears five state fields. It then calls a set of routines with fixed arguments and stores its argument as a state value, recording the result of a further call.

name: flip_flag_around_calls
description: Calls a routine with the value 31, flips a state flag, calls it with the value 15 and flips the flag back. It returns nothing.

name: update_countdown_on_timer_tick
description: Compares a timer reading with a stored value and, once at least 256 units have passed or a pending flag is set, decrements a countdown. When the countdown reaches zero it issues drawing calls for the active entry, toggles the active index, and reloads the countdown from a stored value.

name: format_and_draw_time_text
description: Converts a count of 60-unit intervals into minutes and seconds and formats it as text with a leading zero where needed. It then sets the drawing state and draws each of the five characters at positions offset by the arguments.

name: draw_filled_box_with_outline
description: Sets the pen to 31 and fills a block 34 units wide and 11 high at an offset from the given point. It then traces the outline of a rectangle around the same point with four line segments.

name: switch_stored_mode_value
description: Calls a routine with the previously stored value and the new argument, then stores the argument as the current value. It also refreshes two entries and issues a small set of calls with fixed arguments.

name: prepare_selection_screen_loop
description: Initialises a record and its text buffers, then loops reading input values until the value is 1 or 2. Values from 3 to 6 are stored as the selection and update each entry through a routine, and when the loop ends with 1 the selection is mapped to an interval of 60, 30, 20 or 10 and stored.

name: poll_selection_and_store_interval
description: Repeats until the value read is 1 or 2, storing values from 3 to 6 as the selection and updating the entries through a routine. When the final value is 1 it maps the selection to an interval of 60, 30, 20 or 10 and stores that interval.

name: refresh_selection_display
description: Sets a state flag from bit 128 of a record field, then calls two routines with the shared text buffer and the stored interval value. It returns nothing.

name: clear_flag_and_refresh_display
description: Clears the state flag and then calls two routines with the shared text buffer and the stored interval value.

name: update_linked_entries_by_id
description: Walks a linked list of records and, for each record whose flag bit is set and whose second flag bit is clear, stores a base value in its field. When the record's identifier matches the argument, that field is offset by 40 instead.

name: invoke_single_routine_once
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns.

name: show_result_screen_until_input
description: Prepares a text buffer and draws a result message chosen from the stored scores, the consecutive-pass count and a tie check. It then waits in a loop until the input routine returns 1, clears the display and finishes by calling a routine with a code of 9 or 7 selected by a stored flag.

name: position_four_list_entries
description: Walks four consecutive entries of a list, storing a value from a parameter array into each one and positioning it at half the gap between a global width and the measured width. It returns nothing.

name: draw_numeric_field_for_slot
description: Draws the frame for the current slot and prints its value in a two-character numeric field with a colon prefix. The frame and text positions come from the slot's stored coordinates and the argument.

name: find_text_length_fitting_width
description: Measures a string and shortens the character count one step at a time until the measured width fits within the given limit. It returns the number of characters that fit, or zero for an empty string.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

name: refresh_two_indexed_entries
description: Refreshes up to two indexed entries by calling the shared routine twice for each one, first with flag 0 and then with flag 1. An index of 5 or more is skipped.

name: initialise_name_entry_state
description: Clears seven state fields, sets fixed position constants and copies text entries for the name and label prompts. It then fills a table of 144 bytes with a counter that increases when a test routine reports zero or the index is past 135.

name: forward_argument_with_global_buffers
description: Passes its argument and a pointer to the global buffer to a routine, then calls another routine with the constant 260 and zero. It returns nothing.

name: repeat_routine_fifteen_times
description: Calls a no-argument routine fifteen times in a row and returns nothing.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it has no effect.

name: draw_menu_entry_by_index
description: Returns its input unchanged while a busy flag is set. Otherwise, when two state flags are nonzero, it draws the entry for the given index through a switch over six cases, each issuing its own drawing calls at fixed coordinates and setting a state flag to 0 or 1.

name: clear_selection_state_fields
description: When a display flag is set it issues drawing calls with stored values and the constant 255, then zeroes seven state fields.

name: draw_indexed_tile_box
description: For indices outside 84 to 87, or when a flag is clear, draws a rectangle at coordinates taken from an index table and calls a routine with the index. For the four special indices it draws two rectangles with positions derived from global offsets, each followed by a call with the index.

name: enable_mode_and_refresh
description: Calls the shared routine with the index pairs (2, 0) and (1, 1), sets a flag to 1, and then calls a routine with a stored value.

name: disable_mode_and_refresh
description: Calls the shared routine with the index pairs (1, 0) and (2, 1), clears a flag to 0, and then calls a routine with no arguments.

name: enable_alternate_pair_flag
description: Calls the shared routine with the index pairs (5, 0) and (4, 1) and sets a second flag to 1.

name: disable_alternate_pair_flag
description: Calls the shared routine with the index pairs (4, 0) and (5, 1) and clears a second flag to 0.

name: call_fixed_index_pair
description: Calls a routine with the constant 258 and zero and returns nothing.

name: compare_two_reads_and_report
description: Reads two values from a source with a sequence of calls and compares them. When they are equal it clears a global and returns 1; otherwise it passes the code 4 to a routine and returns 0.

name: report_code_four_and_fail
description: Passes the code 4 to a routine and returns zero.

name: set_peek_flag_and_draw
description: Sets a state flag to 1 and then issues three calls that draw the Peek label and its surrounding area. It returns nothing.

name: check_remove_request_and_draw
description: Reads a text value into a 256-byte buffer and, when the read reports a nonzero result, issues two drawing calls. It then clears a state flag to 0.

name: record_tile_move_count
description: When the state is 4, advances the active player's count and resets the turn values. It then chooses which stored tile values to redraw by comparing them with a reference, saves the three current tile values in a table indexed by the tile counter, steps that counter down by two, and clears the working values.

name: clear_state_flag_then_call
description: Clears a state flag to 0 and calls a no-argument routine. It returns nothing.

name: draw_four_indexed_slot_boxes
description: Draws a fixed frame at coordinates from global values, then loops over the indices 84 to 87 drawing each entry's rectangle and issuing an index call. It finishes with a call that passes the values 1 and 1.

name: update_stage_then_wait
description: Draws the status line and then, depending on the peek state and the stage value, sets the stage to 10, 6 or 5 and redraws the matching element. It then waits in a loop until the input routine returns a nonzero value before drawing a final element.

name: draw_tile_pair_and_advance
description: Looks up the current tile record and draws the matching tile values from the tile table, choosing entries by whether the record matches a stored value. It then steps the tile counter up by two and issues a special call when the counter reaches 144, followed by drawing the final entries.

name: redraw_matched_tile_pair
description: Looks up the current tile record and draws two tile table entries, choosing their order by whether the record matches a stored value. It then steps the tile counter up by two, issues a special call when the counter reaches 144, and draws the final entries.

name: redraw_tile_pair_entries
description: Draws four tile table entries for the current tile in alternating pairs, then steps the tile counter up by two, issues a special call when the counter reaches 144, and draws the final entries.

name: enable_flag_store_constant
description: Sets a state flag to 1, stores the constant 88 in another state field, and calls a no-argument routine. It returns nothing.

name: link_tile_slot_and_mark
description: Follows the stored link for the given slot index when one exists, marks the target entry with 1, and increments the slot's counter. It then calls a routine with the index.

name: link_tile_slot_from_frame
description: Follows the stored link for the slot index kept in the frame, marks the target entry with 1, and increments the slot's counter. It then calls a routine with the index.

name: check_tile_selectable_index
description: Returns 0 when the tile entry is empty, when one of the indices 84 to 87 is blocked by a flag, or when its linked entries are occupied, with a separate rule for index 2. Otherwise it returns 1.

name: check_tile_selectable_from_frame
description: Reads the index from the frame and applies the blocked-index, index-2 and linked-entry rules without the empty-entry check. It returns 1 when the tile is available.

name: check_tile_free_from_frame
description: Reads the index from the frame and applies the index-2 rule and the linked-entry rules only. It returns 1 when the tile is available.

name: check_tile_neighbours_free
description: Returns 0 when both linked entries for the index are occupied. Otherwise indices below 89 are free, and higher indices are free only when their linked entry is empty.

name: check_linked_tile_empty
description: Returns 1 for indices below 89. For higher indices it returns 0 when the linked entry is occupied and 1 otherwise.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value 1 and performs no other work.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value 1 and performs no other work.

name: draw_remaining_tiles_label
description: Formats the tile count held in a global into a text buffer and draws it at a fixed position, with calls that set the pen and position around it.

name: draw_stage_layout_by_index
description: Maps its argument minus one to one of about twenty cases, and each case issues a fixed series of drawing calls with small code arguments. Several cases depend on the stage value and the tile counter, and the function returns the result of its last call.

name: draw_status_row_with_flags
description: Selects a pen from the first argument when the mode argument is 0 or 1, then walks up to four entries and draws each one whose flag is 0 or 1 at a position built from its index. It returns nothing.

name: check_stage_in_range
description: Returns 1 when the stage value is between 1 and 4 inclusive, and 0 otherwise.

name: reset_stage_for_redraw
description: When the stage value is 6 it sets the stage to 2, and when it is 5 it sets the stage to 1. Each case then issues a redraw sequence chosen by a stored flag, and other stage values do nothing.

name: draw_default_layout_sequence
description: Issues one fixed drawing call with a set of small codes that draws the default layout. It returns nothing.

name: set_stage_two_and_draw
description: Sets the stage value to 2, issues a call with the codes 2 and 2, and draws one of two fixed layouts depending on a stored flag.

name: draw_default_layout_sequence
description: Issues one fixed drawing call with a set of small codes that draws the default layout. It returns nothing.

name: pop_list_head_for_index
description: Clears the link of the current head entry for the index, moves the head to the next entry and decrements the entry count, then calls a routine with the index and the new head.

name: draw_board_cell_with_neighbours
description: Computes a cell's row and column from its index on a 15-column grid, chooses label offsets by edge position, and draws the cell's frame. It then loops over surrounding cells and draws each occupied one's symbol and box, adding a highlight for two special indices when a flag is set.

name: await_input_choice_setup
description: Stores its argument in a record, prepares a drawing call, and loops reading input values until one of them is 1 or 2. It returns the final value read.

name: build_text_list_and_wait
description: Copies up to 255 bytes of text into a 256-byte buffer, terminates up to four entries with zero bytes, and records each entry's pointer and position. It then waits in a loop until the input routine returns 1 or 2 and returns that value.

name: wait_for_choice_value
description: Issues a call with the shared buffer, loops reading input until the value is 1 or 2, issues a closing call and returns that value.

name: wait_for_confirm_after_setup
description: Stores its argument in a record, sets a display code of 18 in one field and issues a call. It then loops reading input until the value is 1, issues a closing call and returns the final value.

name: poll_messages_until_count
description: Repeatedly fetches messages from a port, discarding those of one special type and copying the rest into a 52-byte buffer before releasing them. It loops until a counter reaches 64 and returns a 16-bit field from the last record.

name: forward_index_with_globals
description: Passes its argument together with two global values and a pointer to a global buffer to a routine and returns nothing.

name: build_display_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries for the given slot and fills an array of 11-word display records, one per entry. Each record's position and its text or graphic pointer are chosen by the entry's type through a switch, and a summary record is added for the slot.

name: fill_display_record_from_entry
description: Fills a 20-byte display record from an entry by setting a type byte, clearing the link fields, and copying two position words from the entry. It points the buffer field at a global buffer and returns nothing.

name: find_matching_entry_and_draw
description: Searches up to five stored entries for one that matches the record's first value and identifier. When a match is found it draws that entry and returns the value from a further call, then issues a closing call.

name: set_stage_field_and_call
description: Sets two text-layout fields to 63 when the stage value is 3, or to 47 otherwise, copies the second value into a third field, then calls a routine with its argument and the shared buffer.

name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares two strings for up to a given number of characters and returns the difference of the first differing bytes. It returns 1 or -1 when one string ends before the other and zero when they match over the length.

name: scan_unquoted_characters_until_match
description: Walks a string while skipping quoted sections and backslash-escaped characters, passing each unquoted character to a routine until that routine returns nonzero. It returns the number of bytes consumed.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: compare_strings_to_terminator
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns the difference at the first mismatch, or zero when they are identical.

name: invoke_library_vector_30
description: Calls the library function at a fixed vector offset through the library base stored in its argument record. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_tile_table_values
description: Resets seven state fields and sets the tile count to 144. It fills the table with the value 1, sets the first entries to their own indices, and then fills position ranges with the values 1, 2, 3 and 4.

name: return_absolute_value
description: Returns the absolute value of its 16-bit argument.

name: sum_two_call_results
description: Calls two routines without arguments and returns the sum of their results.

name: shuffle_tile_index_table
description: Fills a 144-entry index table with the values 1 to 144, then shuffles it by swapping each position with an earlier one chosen from a routine's result. It records each entry's position in a second table and stores a summed value in a global.

name: reset_count_and_call_pair
description: Sets a count global to 144 and then calls two routines, one with no arguments and one with a pointer to the global buffer.

name: draw_table_entry_and_byte
description: Passes the table entry at the first index to a routine twice, then passes the byte from the global buffer at the second index to another routine.

name: draw_status_panel_frame
description: Sets the pen and draws a framed box using offsets from two global positions, then draws a value at a position derived from a stored index. It finishes with a call that passes the constant 88.

name: redraw_tile_board_grid
description: Returns early when the tile count is zero. Otherwise it draws a grid of 8 columns and 15 rows from the global tile table, then draws the highlighted entries and status items, returning the result of a final call.

name: draw_tile_if_remaining
description: When the count stored for the given index is positive, draws that tile's frame at its stored position, then draws its value and issues a second call with the index. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: find_tile_under_cursor
description: Converts a point into a grid cell by dividing its coordinates by 21 and 24 and clamping the result to the board. It then tests up to nine candidate tiles around that cell with a hit test, selects the first match, and records the selected tile and its value.

name: update_selected_tile_value
description: When a flag is set, tests a fixed special entry with a hit test and selects it if it matches. It then stores the selected tile's identifier and its value from the global table.

name: refresh_selected_tile_value
description: Stores in the selected-value field the table entry at the currently selected tile index.

name: handle_tile_selection_state
description: Runs a small state machine for choosing tiles: in state 0 it selects the current tile, in state 1 it either completes a matching pair or records a second selection, and in state 2 it resets selections depending on whether the current tile matches the saved ones. It issues drawing calls for each transition.

name: apply_tile_selection_transition
description: Applies the same selection transitions as its sibling, but without the initial argument call and the zero-entry test.

name: apply_tile_selection_without_guard
description: Applies the selection transitions for the current tile after its hit check, without the guard that ignores tiles already matched.

name: advance_tile_selection_state
description: Runs the selection state transitions for the current tile without any hit test or entry check. It clears or updates the saved tile values as the state changes.

name: handle_second_selection_state
description: Handles the case where one tile is already selected: when the new tile equals the first one it clears the selection, otherwise it records a second selection and checks the pair. A failed check reverts the state and issues drawing calls, while a passing check issues different drawing calls.

name: record_second_tile_selection
description: Advances the selection state and records the current tile as the second selection. If the pair check fails it steps the state back and clears the second entry, otherwise it issues drawing calls and sets a flag.

name: show_pair_check_feedback
description: Issues a drawing call for the current state, a call with the code 13, and a call with the global buffer, then sets a flag to 1.

name: resolve_pending_second_selection
description: When two selections are pending, it keeps one of them depending on whether the current tile matches a saved value, updating the state and saved values before issuing drawing calls.

name: release_second_selection_state
description: If the current tile equals the saved second selection, it steps the state down and clears that selection. It then issues drawing calls and returns.

name: toggle_tile_selection
description: Ignores the tile when it is empty, or when it is a special index while a flag is set, or when a different tile is already selected. Otherwise it selects the tile and draws its highlight when no selection is active, or clears the selection when one is active.

name: toggle_tile_selection_unchecked
description: Applies the same select-or-clear toggle as its sibling, skipping the initial argument call and the empty-entry test.

name: toggle_selection_without_range
description: Applies the select-or-clear toggle without the special-index test, but still refuses a different tile while one is selected.

name: toggle_selection_state_only
description: Selects the current tile when no selection is active, or clears the selection when one is active, issuing drawing calls for the change.

name: clear_active_selection
description: When one tile is selected it clears the selection and its saved values and issues drawing calls. It does nothing when no tile is selected.

name: remove_selected_tiles_and_reset
description: Redraws the saved tile or its special entry when the saved value differs from the reference, decrements the tile counter, updates the counter display, and resets the selection state fields to zero.

name: remove_selected_tile_and_reset
description: Redraws the saved tile or its special entry, decrements the tile counter, updates the counter display, and resets the selection state fields. Unlike its sibling it does not compare the saved value first.

name: reset_selection_display_state
description: Issues two drawing calls with the codes 14 and 0 and zeroes five selection state fields.

name: check_tile_pick_allowed
description: Returns 1 when the tile index may be picked. Otherwise it issues a feedback call with the code 3 when the linked entries are occupied, or with the code 5 for a blocked special index, and returns 0.

name: check_tile_pick_from_frame
description: Reads the index from the frame and returns 1 when the tile may be picked. It issues a feedback call with the code 3 when linked entries are occupied, or 5 for a blocked special index, and returns 0 in those cases.

name: check_special_tile_blocked
description: Returns 0 and issues feedback code 5 when the frame's index is one of the four special indices while a flag is set. Otherwise it returns 1.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value 1 and performs no other work.

name: run_input_result_loop
description: Draws its opening elements, then loops reading input values: a value of 2 ends the loop returning zero, a pending flag returns a value from a further call, and other values trigger feedback calls. When the loop ends it restores the saved stage and draws its closing elements.

name: poll_input_result_loop
description: Repeats an input-handling loop: when a flag is set it returns a value from a call, otherwise it dispatches feedback calls according to the value read. It returns zero when the read reports 2, and otherwise restores the stage and returns a closing result.

name: read_input_until_result
description: Reads input values in a loop, issuing feedback calls for each value, and leaves when the read returns 2 or a flag is set. A valid selection returns a value from a further call; otherwise it restores the stage and returns the closing result.

name: poll_selection_result_loop
description: Issues a feedback call depending on a stored selection, then repeatedly reads input until a result is reached. A value of 2 returns zero, while a selection restores the stage and returns a closing result.

name: process_input_result_loop
description: Runs an input loop that starts from a different entry point, issuing feedback calls for each value read. It returns the result of a further call when a selection is made and zero when the read reports 2.

name: finish_selection_dispatch
description: Handles the final step after input: when the selection code is 1 and a call succeeds, it stores the stage value and forwards the call's result. Otherwise it restores the stage and issues closing drawing calls.

name: restore_stage_or_close_display
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns nonzero, restores the saved stage value and returns. Otherwise it restores the stage and issues two closing calls.

name: restore_stage_and_close_display
description: Restores the saved stage value and issues two drawing calls, followed by a closing call. It returns nothing.

name: check_named_file_in_directory
description: Reads the current directory into an 854-byte buffer and passes it with a file name to a routine that returns a status. A zero status issues a closing call, while a nonzero status issues a display call followed by a call with that status.

name: run_setup_panel_until_choice
description: Draws a setup panel at fixed sizes, then reads input values until one of 1 or 2 is read. When the value is 1 it finishes the panel with drawing calls and a closing call.

name: confirm_replace_and_set_limit
description: Checks for an existing record and, when the prompt to replace it is shown, loops reading choices from 3 to 6 and redraws the entries for each choice. When the final choice is 1 it stores a time limit of 0, 1200, 600 or 300 according to the choice, then returns 1 or 0 depending on a further call.

name: run_replace_prompt_set_limit
description: Performs the same choice loop and time-limit mapping as its sibling, reading the choice from the frame. It returns zero when the final call fails and one otherwise.

name: poll_choice_and_set_limit
description: Repeats the choice loop until the read returns 1 or 2, redrawing entries for each choice from 3 to 6. A value of 1 maps the choice to a time limit of 0, 1200, 600 or 300, then runs a further call and returns zero or one depending on its result.

name: draw_and_check_result_call
description: Draws two fixed elements and makes a call that yields a result. When that result is nonzero it issues a display call and a closing call, returning 1, and otherwise returns 0.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns the value zero and performs no other work.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the value 1 and performs no other work.

name: draw_time_left_label
description: Draws the time-left text at a position offset from the stored display coordinates. It issues a call with the shared buffer and two drawing calls at the stored coordinates.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

name: build_tournament_result_entries
description: Builds display records for the stored tournament results, one per entry, copying each entry's name and score text and positioning it from the bottom of the list. When there are no entries it points the first record at a shared text buffer.

name: clear_tournament_results
description: Calls a routine with the shared buffer and then resets the stored result count to zero.

name: show_quit_tournament_panel
description: Sets the stage value to 3, sets a state flag to 1, copies the time limit into a counter, and records the result of a timing call. It then issues drawing calls with fixed arguments to present the quit panel.

name: tick_tournament_countdown
description: When at least 256 time units have passed, it decrements the countdown and redraws its display. While a flag is set it issues an alert call every 60 counts, and it issues a further call when the countdown reaches zero.

name: show_tournament_result_screen
description: Draws the tournament result screen with lines chosen by the player's placement and score, then waits in a loop until the input routine returns 1. It finishes by setting the stage to 8 and issuing a closing call.
